skill.name: chat-compactor
skill.description: Creates structured markdown handoff summaries for long AI coding sessions. Use it to preserve decisions, current state, blockers, failed approaches, and next steps.
skill.summary: Create compact session handoffs that help the next AI agent continue work quickly.
skill.author: ZhanlinCui

security_audit.summary: All four static command execution findings are false positives caused by markdown fences and inline filename examples in SKILL.md. No prompt injection or malicious command execution intent was found. A low risk privacy concern remains because saved summaries may preserve sensitive project context.

remediation.issue: Saved summaries may include sensitive project context.
remediation.suggestion: Warn users to omit secrets and prefer ignored storage for session notes.

static_findings.snippet: 4. **Save to file**: `session-[topic]-[date].md` in project root or `/home/claude/sessions/`

finding_verdicts.reason: Line 24 starts a fenced markdown example, not executable shell or Ruby backtick syntax. No command invocation or user-controlled execution path is present.
Line 58 closes the markdown example fence. It is formatting syntax only and cannot execute commands.
The backticks wrap example output paths for a saved markdown file. The line describes a filename convention and contains no external command execution.
The inline backticks mark an example filename in prose. This is not shell execution and no command string is provided.

semantic_findings.title: Sensitive Context Persistence
semantic_findings.description: The workflow asks agents to save session summaries to project root or /home/claude/sessions. Those summaries can contain decisions, file paths, blockers, and environment details.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The save instructions are explicit at both cited lines, but exposure depends on summary contents and repository practices.

content.value_statement: Long coding chats lose decisions, blockers, and file state. This skill creates concise handoff summaries for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
actual_capabilities: Generates a structured markdown handoff with context, accomplishments, current state, blockers, and next steps.
Captures decision rationale and rejected alternatives for future agents.
Documents failed approaches so later sessions avoid repeating them.
Records modified files and relevant environment notes when available in the conversation.
Recommends a predictable session note filename for saved summaries.
Defines trigger phrases for wrapping up long or completed sessions.
limitations: Summary quality depends on the available conversation history.
It does not inspect the repository unless the agent uses tools separately.
It can preserve sensitive details if users include them in the chat.
It does not replace version control, issue tracking, or formal documentation.

use_cases.title: End a Coding Session
use_cases.description: Create a concise handoff before stopping work on an implementation or debugging task.

use_cases.title: Transfer Context Between Agents
use_cases.description: Give a new Claude, Codex, or Claude Code session the decisions, files, blockers, and next actions.

use_cases.title: Record Debugging History
use_cases.description: Capture failed approaches and current state so the team avoids repeating costly investigation paths.

prompt_templates.title: Basic Wrap-Up
prompt_templates.prompt: Use chat-compactor to summarize this session for the next AI agent. Include current state, completed work, blockers, and next steps.

prompt_templates.title: Focused Debugging Handoff
prompt_templates.prompt: Use chat-compactor for this debugging session. Emphasize symptoms, hypotheses tested, failed approaches, useful files, and the next experiment.

prompt_templates.title: Implementation Handoff
prompt_templates.prompt: Use chat-compactor to create a handoff for this feature. Include design decisions, modified files, validation status, risks, and prioritized follow-up work.

prompt_templates.title: Multi-Session Continuity Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Use chat-compactor to prepare a durable project handoff. Separate confirmed facts, assumptions, unresolved questions, environment notes, and actions for the next session.

output_examples.input: User asks to wrap up after implementing an authentication refactor.
output_examples.output: A markdown session note with the refactor goal, completed changes, rejected approaches, current blockers, and next validation step.

output_examples.input: User reaches a long debugging conversation about failing tests.
output_examples.output: A compact handoff listing symptoms, tried fixes, useful files, dead ends, and the next test to run.

output_examples.input: User switches from Claude to Codex during a feature build.
output_examples.output: A continuity summary that names the feature state, decisions, modified areas, environment notes, and prioritized follow-up work.

best_practices: Ask for compaction before the context window becomes difficult to review.
Review the summary for secrets before saving it to a project directory.
Include validation status and remaining uncertainty, not only completed work.
anti_patterns: Do not use vague progress notes without file names, blockers, or next actions.
Do not include secrets, credentials, private tokens, or unreleased customer data.
Do not treat the handoff as a substitute for commits or issue updates.

faq.question: When should I use this skill?
faq.answer: Use it near the end of a long coding, debugging, or planning session.

faq.question: Does it run commands?
faq.answer: No. The skill is written guidance for producing a markdown handoff. Any tool use depends on the hosting agent.

faq.question: Can it save the summary to a file?
faq.answer: It recommends saving a markdown note, but the agent or user must perform the file write.

faq.question: Does it work with Claude Code and Codex?
faq.answer: Yes. The handoff format is plain markdown and suits Claude, Codex, and Claude Code workflows.

faq.question: Will it recover context that is not in the chat?
faq.answer: No. It summarizes visible conversation context unless the agent separately inspects files or tools.

faq.question: How should I handle sensitive information?
faq.answer: Remove secrets and private data before saving or sharing the summary.
